p: my knowledge from afar: He shows that when we speak of God, we must lift our spirits higher than our natural sense is able to reach.
perfect in knowledge is with thee: You will perceive that I am a faithful instructor, and that I speak to you in the name of God.

mighty in strength and wisdom: Strong and constant, and of understanding: for these are the gifts of God, and he loves them in man: but as much as God punished Job now, it is a sign that these are not in him.
preserveth not the life of the: Therefore he will not preserve the wicked, but to the humble and afflicted heart he will show grace.
kings are they on the throne: He prefers the godly to honour.
work: He will move their hearts to feel their sins that they may come to him by repentance as he did Manasseh.
without knowledge: That is, in their folly or obstinacy, and so shall cause their own destruction.
in heart heap up wrath: Which are maliciously bent against God, and flatter themselves in their vices.
cry not when he bindeth them: When they are in affliction they do not seek God for help, as Asa in 2Ch 16:12.
youth: They die of some vile death, and that before they come to age.
that which should be set on: If you had been obedient to God, he would have brought you to freedom and wealth.
judgment of the wicked: You are altogether after the manner of the wicked: for you murmur against the justice of God.
Because there is wrath: God punishes you, lest you forget God in your wealth and so perish.
Desire not the night: Do not be curious in seeking the cause of God's judgments, when he destroys any.
iniquity: And so murmur against God through impatiency.
afar off: The works of God are revealed, that a man may see them afar off, and know God by the same.
and we know him not: Our infirmity hinders us so that we cannot attain the perfect knowledge of God.
pour down rain according to the: That is, the rain comes from those drops of water which he keeps in the clouds.
tabernacle: Meaning, of the clouds, which he calls the tabernacle of God.
it: Upon the cloud.
bottom of the sea: That men cannot come to the knowledge of the springs of it.
the people: He shows that the rain has a double use: the one that it declares God's judgments, when it overflows any places, and the other that it makes the land fruitful.
betwixt: That is, one cloud to dash against another.

The noise thereof sheweth concerning it: The cold vapour shows him: that is, the cloud of the hot exhalation, which being taken in the cold cloud mounts up toward the place where the fire is, and so anger is engendered; that is, noise and thunderclaps.
